newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Nov 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Nov 28.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- UAE asks GCC to normalise ties with Iraq.
- Dubai gold imports soar to new peak.
- Gulf Air and British Midland have announced a wide code-sharing agreement which will add five new UK destinations to Gulf Air's global network.
- UAE gold demand grew 35 percent to 10.8 tonnes in the third quarter of 1996 compared with the same period last year.
- Bahrain announced on Wednesday it would boycott the GCC summit, saying Qatar's behaviour was "unbrotherly and lacking in warmth".

- Dubai's Chamber of Commerce and Industry said re-exports from Dubai in the first half of 1996 were worth 8.1 billion dirhams, up 39.6 percent over the year ago period. It said it expected the value of re-exports in the full year 1996 to reach 16 billion dirhams.
